verdict.rationale: Martin is an AI personal-assistant service, and shipping an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence lists its interfaces as phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email, Slack, a web app and a desktop app, but none of it mentions a command-line tool. The probes also found no OpenAPI spec that a CLI might build on, so the axis applies but has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
